sections.name: classifyReactorSubIndustry
sections.title: Map reactor code to segment
sections.what: Turns a reactor family code and its electric capacity into one named nuclear segment. Light-water reactors are split into small or large by capacity, other known codes map directly, and unknown input returns nothing.
sections.why: The header comment says this must match the PRIS backfill exactly, so both give the same segment for the same reactor.
sections.watch_out: Each returned name must match a segment name in the industry list exactly, and renaming a segment there silently breaks this mapping.

summary: Maps a nuclear reactor family code and its electric capacity to one named reactor segment, and returns nothing for unknown input.
purpose: Gives one answer for each reactor's segment, so the reactor backfill and the app agree.
why: The header comment says it must mirror the PRIS reconciliation backfill exactly.
how: First it trims the reactor code and makes it uppercase. For light-water reactors, capacity decides between small and large segments. For other known codes, the segment name comes from a fixed mapping. Codes containing the words research or test map to research reactors. Anything else returns nothing.
inputs: A reactor family code as text, which may be empty, and an electric capacity in megawatts, which may be empty.
outputs: A segment name as text, or nothing.
risks: The names returned must match the segment names in the industry list exactly, and nothing in this file checks that. A capacity of zero is treated as unknown and counts as large.
debug: If a reactor lands in the wrong segment, check the code and capacity it was given. If a reactor gets no segment, check whether its code is in the mapping or contains the words research or test. If a segment name looks different from the industry list, compare the spelling.
